name: UV-Vis TD-DFT (PBE0)
template:
# Vertical UV-Vis absorption (20 singlet roots). PBE0 is a solid general-purpose
# global hybrid; for charge-transfer / Rydberg states prefer the range-separated
# CAM-B3LYP recipe. Run on a ground-state optimised geometry. Add CPCM(<solvent>)
# to the keyword line for solution spectra.

! PBE0 def2-TZVP RIJCOSX def2/J D4

%maxcore 3000

%pal nprocs 8
end

%tddft
  nroots 20
  maxdim 5
  tda true
end
